name: 24-Hour Room Service Crisp Plant-Based Chicken Sandwich with Sweet Potato Fries
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder, Magic & Treasure · 24-Hour Stateroom Dining
whyItWorks: Dairy-free plant-based chicken patty on a soft toasted bun, though garlic aioli and fried coating require remission tolerance.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for no garlic aioli, remove raw Vidalia onions and lettuce, and blot excess oil from the sweet potato fries.
